import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by passenger class and sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_by_class_sex_percent = survival_by_class_sex.div(survival_by_class_sex.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x = np.arange(len(survival_by_class_sex_percent.index))
width = 0.35

for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    offset = width * i - width/2
    bars = ax1.bar(x + offset, 
                   survival_by_class_sex_percent[survived].values,
                   width, 
                   label='Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive',
                   color='#2ecc71' if survived == 1 else '#e74c3c',
                   alpha=0.8)
    
    # Add percentage labels
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        if height > 5:  # Only label bars with significant height
            ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
                    f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class and Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([f'Class {pclass} {sex}' for (pclass, sex) in survival_by_class_sex_percent.index])
ax1.legend(title='Outcome')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 110)

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_data = [df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna(), 
            df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()]

violin_parts = ax2.violinplot(age_data, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for i, pc in enumerate(violin_parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor('#2ecc71' if i == 1 else '#e74c3c')
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')

violin_parts['cmeans'].set_color('yellow')
violin_parts['cmedians'].set_color('black')

ax2.set_xlabel('Survival Status')
ax2.set_ylabel('Age')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks([1, 2])
ax2.set_xticklabels(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])

# Subplot 3: Survival by embarkation port
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival_percent = embark_survival.div(embark_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

colors = ['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71']
for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    ax3.bar(embark_survival_percent.index, 
            embark_survival_percent[survived], 
            bottom=embark_survival_percent.loc[:, :survived-1].sum(axis=1) if survived > 0 else 0,
            label='Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive',
            color=colors[survived],
            alpha=0.8)

ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax3.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Outcome')
ax3.set_ylim(0, 110)

# Subplot 4: Fare distribution by passenger class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    fare_data = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]['fare'].dropna()
    sns.kdeplot(data=fare_data, ax=ax4, label=f'Class {pclass}', fill=True, alpha=0.5)

ax4.set_xlabel('Fare')
ax4.set_ylabel('Density')
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Passenger Class')
ax4.set_xlim(0, df['fare'].quantile(0.99))  # Remove extreme outliers for better visualization

# Subplot 5: Family size vs survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby(['family_size', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
family_survival_percent = family_survival.div(family_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x_family = np.arange(len(family_survival_percent))
for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    ax5.plot(x_family, family_survival_percent[survived], 
             marker='o', markersize=8, linewidth=2,
             label='Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive',
             color='#2ecc71' if survived == 1 else '#e74c3c')

ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size (including passenger)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xticks(x_family)
ax5.set_xticklabels(family_survival_percent.index)
ax5.legend(title='Outcome')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 6: Survival by age groups
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], 
                         labels=['Child (0-12)', 'Teen (13-18)', 'Young Adult (19-30)', 
                                 'Adult (31-50)', 'Senior (51+)'])
age_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
age_survival_percent = age_survival.div(age_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x_age = np.arange(len(age_survival_percent))
width = 0.35

for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    offset = width * i - width/2
    bars = ax6.bar(x_age + offset, 
                   age_survival_percent[survived].values,
                   width, 
                   label='Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive',
                   color='#2ecc71' if survived == 1 else '#e74c3c',
                   alpha=0.8)
    
    # Add percentage labels
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 1,
                f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax6.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xticks(x_age)
ax6.set_xticklabels(age_survival_percent.index)
ax6.legend(title='Outcome')
ax6.set_ylim(0, 110)

# Add overall title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
